lesson: Verification with json.assert. It validates a value against a declared schema and returns passed true with an evidenceHash over the value, or fails the task when the value does not satisfy the schema. Use it to make a claim checkable rather than asserted in prose: assert the shape of a result before reporting it. The supported schema subset is explicit and fails closed, covering type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, const, minimum, maximum, minLength, maxLength, minItems, maxItems, anyOf and oneOf. An unsupported keyword is rejected as INVALID_SCHEMA rather than ignored.
